subject: Technical screen — connectivity check & debrief capture plan
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@gmail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical screen — connectivity check & debrief capture plan

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. We have a 45-minute ML/coding screen scheduled for Monday 10 May at 11:00 AM PT. Before we lock the session, two quick asks so the session runs smoothly:

1) Connectivity check: can you confirm you can join a short connectivity check (5–7 min) on Monday at 10:40 AM PT? We use CoderPad for live coding and expect webcam + mic for brief intro.

2) Recording & consent: we record the session for internal debrief only. If you’re uncomfortable, tell us and we’ll note it.

3) Debrief capture: after the screen we capture interviewer notes in a short template (linked below). This helps speed feedback.

I attached your resume we have on file for quick reference. If anything on the resume has changed, please reply with an updated copy.

Attachments (stubs): candidate_resume.pdf
Links: https://coderpad.io/session/ABCD1234 (join link will be provided in a follow-up calendar invite)

If Monday 11:00 AM PT doesn't work, please propose two alternatives this week and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

--
[Attachment: candidate_resume.pdf (PDF, 260 KB)]

Thanks Mateo — Monday 10 May at 11:00 AM PT works for me. I can do the 10:40 AM quick connectivity check as well.

I consent to recording for internal debrief. No changes to the resume right now.

One accessibility note: I prefer captions if available, but it's not required. I'll join from a quiet laptop and use Chrome.

See you Monday —
Hannah

Hi Hannah — great, invite sent. Quick logistics below and the join link for the live session.

- Connectivity check: 10:40 AM PT (please click the CoderPad link below and test mic/webcam). I’ll be on the check to confirm audio/video.
- Live screen: 11:00–11:45 AM PT. Interviewer: Kimberly Park (Staff SWE).
- Platform: CoderPad (we'll use the Python pad + small ML prompt). Bring your usual editor if you'd like to take notes.
- Recording: will start at the beginning of the session (internal use only).

Join link (also on calendar invite): https://coderpad.io/session/ABCD1234
Calendar attachment: techscreen-invite.ics
Debrief template (internal): https://drive.redwood/company/hiring/debriefs/debrief-template.md

Best,

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Technical screen — connectivity check & debrief capture plan

Mateo / Neha — quick internal debrief following Hannah's screen (notes taken in the debrief template). Keeping it short: 

> Candidate: Hannah Cho
> Role: ML Engineer (IC2)
> Time: 11:00–11:45 AM PT
> Interviewer: Kimberly Park (Staff SWE)

Score summary:
- Problem solving (coding): 4/5 — implemented clean iterative solution; minor off-by-one bug that was fixed after prompting.
- ML systems design: 3/5 — good conceptual understanding of batching and KV caching; could be more specific about quantization tradeoffs.
- Communication & collaboration: 5/5 — clear, concise, accepted hints well.

Notes: used the provided CoderPad prompt; candidate navigated the pad fine. Recording saved to internal folder. Recommend: move to take-home (next step) and loop in hiring committee.

Action items:
- Mateo: share candidate thumbs-up and next-step invite + take-home instructions.
- Neha: prepare take-home rubric and scheduling windows.

Thanks — I marked the debrief template with the filled scores and short bullets (see link).

Kim
Kimberly Park
Staff Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
